messages.subject: Glimmer Server can't find javascript files?
parts:
Ok, so I have a working app that was deployed on glimmer, and runs perfectly both on my machine using runApp() and on my personal shiny-server, but when I made a slight change to the wording of one of the helpText elements and re-uploaded everything, it no longer seems to be able to find the javascript files.

GET http://glimmer.rstudio.com/srvanderplas/SineIllusionShiny/shared/bootstrap/css/bootstrap-responsive.min.css 404 (Not Found) [VM] (816):5
GET http://glimmer.rstudio.com/srvanderplas/SineIllusionShiny/shared/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.min.js 404 (Not Found) [VM] (816):5
  1. Uncaught ReferenceError: jQuery is not defined actionbutton.js:1
  1. Uncaught ReferenceError: $ is not defined shinyBindings.js:5
  1. Uncaught ReferenceError: $ is not defined

Does anyone have a clue what's going on? The only apparent difference between the glimmer server and my home server is that glimmer is running R version 2.15.3, and my home server is running 3.0.1, but I can't understand why this would be a problem. I tried changing the ./www/js/ folder to ./shared/js/ to see if the errors were that simple to fix, but that did not change anything. 

I'm a bit flummoxed. Both shiny (0.6.0) and shinyIncubator (0.1.0) are of the same version.
